page: Google Cloud Platform z4m-highmem-48 is a storage-optimized virtual machine instance based on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 48 dedicated virtual CPUs and 366 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.62 GB of memory per core. It is engineered specifically for applications demanding a combination of compute density, substantial memory footprint, and high-capacity integrated storage without dedicated GPU acceleration.

A prominent hardware characteristic of this instance is the local storage subsystem, which incorporates 45,097 GB of bundled NVMe SSD storage distributed across local drives. This integrated high-density NVMe array provides low-latency physical block storage directly coupled to the host system. Networking configurations on the instance include zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring standard VPC routing or secondary address allocation for external egress and ingress.

In terms of operational and cost efficiency, z4m-highmem-48 consolidates massive NVMe local storage with high memory capacity on dedicated x86_64 cores. This dense provisioning reduces the overhead of provisioning external block storage volumes for I/O-intensive workloads. The server configuration is suited for large-scale distributed databases, analytical storage engines, NoSQL datastores, transactional data warehousing, and high-throughput data processing pipelines that require direct NVMe storage access alongside extensive in-memory working sets.
description: Google Cloud Platform z4m-highmem-48 is a storage-optimized virtual machine configured with 48 dedicated x86_64 virtual CPUs and 366 GB of system RAM, yielding 7.62 GB of memory per core. The instance includes 45,097 GB of high-capacity local NVMe SSD storage, eliminating the need for separate network-attached disks for high-throughput primary data storage. Lacking GPU acceleration and complimentary public IPv4 addresses, the instance directs its hardware allocation entirely toward compute, high memory capacity, and expansive local solid-state storage. By uniting large local flash capacity with dedicated processor cores and high-density memory, the instance delivers a consolidated footprint for data-heavy operations. These architectural attributes position z4m-highmem-48 for deployment in write-heavy distributed databases, NoSQL stores, transactional logging engines, big data analytics pipelines, and data warehouse applications requiring high local I/O performance and expansive in-memory cache capacity.
